title: Add print-template migration presets for the 16 legacy bill-export families so their registry entries leave dataset-ready
description: Stage 2 registry gap: the 16 print-template registry entries for the legacy bill-export families (LegacyKey 'print-template:{familyKey}', DatasetKey 'bill-export:{familyKey}') reach only dataset-ready because ReportConfigurationPresetManifest.Presets has no preset keyed to their 'print-template:{familyKey}' LegacyKeys — the bill-export presets are keyed 'export:bill-proc:{familyKey}' instead (ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.cs:291-323). ReportMigrationPresetCatalog.HasPresetAsync matches strictly by LegacyKey (ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.cs:865-872), so those 16 entries can never advance to preset-ready/parity-passed and CanRetireLegacyRoutes stays permanently false for the print-template dimension. Add one preset per LegacyBillExportCatalog.Families entry reusing the existing BillExportPresetDefinition(familyKey), keyed 'print-template:{familyKey}' with DatasetKey equal to the family's bill-export dataset key, so the 16 entries reach preset-ready; preserve fail-closed behavior (never parity-passed without four-dimension evidence). No new controller/designer/exporter, no arbitrary SQL, no schema/seed/migration changes, no secrets/env, no permission expansion; only the preset manifest plus regression tests. Not audit-only: it unblocks correct parity derivation for 16 genuinely migrated print-template entries.
acceptance_criteria: ReportConfigurationPresetManifest.Presets contains a preset for each of the 16 LegacyBillExportCatalog.Families with LegacyKey 'print-template:{familyKey}', DatasetKey equal to the family's bill-export dataset key, and a definition reusing BillExportPresetDefinition(familyKey), so HasPresetAsync('print-template:{familyKey}') returns true for all 16 families.

The 16 'print-template:{familyKey}' registry entries advance from dataset-ready to preset-ready when their dataset and menu authorization are present, never reach parity-passed without complete four-dimension evidence, and existing 'export:bill-proc:{familyKey}' presets plus single-dataset parity derivation remain unchanged and fail-closed.

Add/update executable unit coverage asserting all 16 print-template bill-family presets are registered and the corresponding entries reach preset-ready, with no regression in the existing print-template and legacy bill-export migration tests. Run related tests plus the safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportConfigurationPrintTemplateCatalog.cs:88-99 adds the 16 LegacyBillExportCatalog families with Supported=true and DatasetKey=bill.DatasetKey; :37-49 derives LegacyKey 'print-template:'+f.FamilyKey. src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.cs:291-323 registers bill-export presets only under LegacyKey 'export:bill-proc:{familyKey}', and :324-362 registers print-template presets only for the 7 master + 2 sales-document families, so ReportMigrationPresetCatalog.HasPresetAsync (ReportConfigurationPresetCatalog.cs:865-872, strict OrdinalIgnoreCase LegacyKey match) returns false for every 'print-template:{billFamilyKey}'. src/ERP.UnitTests/ReportConfigurationPrintTemplateCatalogTests.cs:696-699 asserts print-template:sales-order stays DatasetReady, proving the missing preset.
